messages.subject: Re: rattle _ 2.1.28. zip needed!
messages.body_plain:
You should use the latest version of R, which is 2.5.1. Follow the instructions at http://datamining.togaware.com/survivor/Installing_GTK.html focusing on the instructions for MS/Windows. Thus you will: 1) Install the GTK+ libraries 2) Install R Then get a copy of the required R packages to the computer and put them into some folder, e.g., C:\Rpackages. This will include files like RGtk2_2.10.11.zip, and many others, which are available, for example, from http://cran.at.r-project.org/bin/windows/contrib/r-release/ One simple approach is to grab everything in this folder and transfer them across to your C:\Rpackages. Then start up R, and from the menus select the option to install packages from local folder (or something like that - I don't have a windows machine in front of me at present). In the resulting window that pops up browse to the C:\Rpackages folder, then select all of the packages you would like to install, including rattle. Hope that helps to get you started. > Thanx Graham,

>
> I followed ur guidlines and have successfully installed R on windows XP

> I am listing the steps that i went through so maybe others can have
> idea....
> Installing R on  MS Windows operating system WITH GUI
> 1. DOWNLOAD THE FOLLOWING

>  1.gtk-dev-2.10.11-win32-1 11.9 MB

>        "MASS", "mice", "network", "pmml", "randomForest",

>        "rggobi", "ROCR", "RODBC", "rpart", "RSvgDevice",

>        "XML")
> 2.STEPS TO INSTALL R
>  1.Install the GTK+ libraries "gtk-dev-2.10.11-win32-1 11.9 MB"
>  2.Install R "R-2.5.1-win32 28 MB"
>  3.Make a folder on ur hard disk like "C://ABC" n place all R packages in it and also place
>    rattle_2.2.60 370 kB + RGtk2_2.10.11 14.7 MB in it.
>  4.Than right click on R icon on desktop , in quick launch bar and in start
>    menu and select properties, select shortcut tab and set start-in to
>    the path of ur working directory u created in step 3
>  5.Install RGtk2 "RGtk2_2.10.11 14.7 MB"  by selecting packages tab from R
>    and choosing option "install packages from local zip files..." from
>    the directory u have created in step 3 and where u have already placed

>    + RGtk2_2.10.11 14.7 MB.

>  7.Install Rattle "rattle_2.2.60 370 kB" in the same way mentioned above in step 5.
>  8.Start Rattle by typing library(rattle) on command line and press enter
>  9.To start the Rattle GUI simply run the command:
